# DevExpress PDF Drawing Library

`DevExpress.Pdf.Drawing` connects the PDF document engine in `DevExpress.Pdf.Core` with graphics primitives in `DevExpress.Drawing`. This connection allows DevExpress products to render PDF pages using the shared drawing infrastructure. 


You do not need to install this package separately. It is installed as a dependency of the following DevExpress products:

You do not need to install this package separately. It is installed as a common dependency with the following DevExpress products:


* [Office & PDF File API](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/office-file-api/) - PDF Document API

* [WinForms Controls](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/winforms/) - PDF Viewer

* [WPF Controls](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/wpf/) - PDF Viewer

* [Blazor Controls](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/blazor/) - PDF Viewer

* [DevExpress Reports](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/reporting/) - PDF export and rendering
